stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the core area of large language models (LLMs) and text generation.
The associated tags indicate relevance to transformers, safetensors, and the Llama family of models.

stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Meta Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model licensed under Apache 2.0, targeting local coding agents.
The model is optimized for local deployment via Ollama, featuring native DFlash and image input support.

stories.title: Meta and Apple team up to make Muse AI models run better on Macs
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: Meta unveiled Muse Spark, positioning it as a leading US open-weight AI model.
The collaboration enables Muse AI models to run locally on Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios.
This integration leverages the MLX framework, facilitating desktop-level performance for advanced AI.

stories.title: Targeted ads delivered 0-click exploits to install mercenary malware
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: Targeted advertisements are being weaponized to deliver 0-click exploits.
The exploits are used to install mercenary spyware on victims' devices.
This incident suggests a significant, confirmed evolution in cyberattack vectors.

stories.title: Muse Spark Open
stories.author: bigwheels
bullet_points: Meta has released 'Muse Spark Open,' indicating a significant push toward open-source AI models.
The availability on Hugging Face suggests broad accessibility for developers and researchers.
This launch positions Meta in the competitive landscape of large language models (LLMs) with a focus on openness.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized for text-generation and conversational AI tasks.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under key AI/ML tags such as 'transformers', 'llama', and 'text-generation'.
This indicates ongoing community interest and benchmarking activity around Llama 3 variants.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a 30B parameter open model, is now accessible via Ollama.
The model is specifically designed for autonomous agents capable of multi-step tasks and tool calling.
It is optimized to run locally on user hardware, emphasizing on-device AI capabilities.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a substantial developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved within Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance shows up to a 90% speed increase when benchmarked using Aider.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in the MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher output quality, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: ChatGPT can peek at your Chrome tabs now
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: ChatGPT's Chrome extension now has the capability to view the user's open browser tabs.
This feature allows users to reference their current browsing context directly within the ChatGPT interface.
The update replaces or supersedes previous dedicated tools like ChatGPT Atlas.

stories.title: AVALON: Zero-Shot Indoor Navigation with Human-Seeded Topological Memory
stories.author: Shiyan Hu
bullet_points: Introduces AVALON, a novel topological navigation framework for service robots in unmapped indoor environments.
Key innovation is using human-seeded layered spatial memory, allowing robots to operate without prior site-specific training.
The system incorporates node-verified topological execution and evidence-gated memory co-updating between human and robot.

stories.title: Your Transformer Is Secretly Elastic
stories.author: Cees G. M. Snoek
bullet_points: Addresses the rigidity of fixed-size transformer models when deployed across diverse hardware and fluctuating workloads.
Proposes a novel, retraining-free method to 'elastify' pre-trained transformers.
Enables a single model to dynamically adapt its computational requirements across a continuum of needs.

stories.title: DialFork: Going Beyond Factuality to Evaluate Procedural Hallucination in Conversational Agents
stories.author: Petr Motlicek
bullet_points: Introduces DialFork, a novel benchmark specifically designed to test for procedural hallucination in conversational AI.
Addresses a critical, under-researched failure mode where LLMs deviate from intended conversational logic despite being factually fluent.
Highlights the growing industry need to evaluate LLMs not just on factual accuracy, but also on adherence to procedural reasoning.

stories.title: Run AI agents safely with Ollama and Fly.io
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama enables the deployment of AI agents using its cloud models.
The integration allows these agents to run securely within Fly.io's cloud infrastructure.
This combination addresses the need for safe and scalable deployment of AI agents.

stories.title: Ollama now supports Jev-style decision models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has expanded its capabilities to support Jev-style decision models.
These new models leverage TypeSafe's Jev API for fast, typed decision-making.
Decision models can provide probabilistic answers (yes/no, choices, scores) at low latency and no cost.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI platforms with local, open-source LLM ecosystems.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release introduces performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden the range of supported models and hardware.
It specifically augments Ollama's MLX engine for better performance on Apple silicon.

stories.title: The Tesla Roadster flew, drove upside down, and hit 60mph in under a second
stories.author: Andrew J. Hawkins
bullet_points: Tesla demonstrated a next-generation Roadster capable of brief flight and driving upside down.
The vehicle achieved a 0-60 mph acceleration in under one second during the demonstration.
The event showcased a highly advanced prototype, aligning with Elon Musk's vision for flying vehicles.

stories.title: Bluesky’s AI tool now lets you make games and apps to share on social
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: Bluesky's AI tool, Attie AI, has expanded its functionality beyond feed customization.
Users can now leverage Attie AI to create small, shareable social applications like games, polls, and dashboards.
This development positions Bluesky as a platform enabling user-generated, interactive social experiences.

stories.title: Black Sea drone attacks enter NATO country's territorial waters for first time
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Suspected Russian drones have entered the territorial waters of a NATO country (Romania).
The attacks targeted a chemical tanker within Romanian waters.
This marks the first reported instance of such drone incursions into the country's waters.

stories.title: Qwen-Audio-Jev: A Unified Interface for Audio Decisions
stories.author: Wupeng Wang
bullet_points: Introduces Qwen-Audio-Jev, a new model designed to improve efficiency in high-throughput audio applications.
Addresses the computational overhead and latency associated with autoregressive text generation in Large Audio Language Models (LALMs).
Unifies audio decision-making tasks—selection, binary judgment, and scoring—using a dedicated Jev decision head.

stories.title: Learning Intrinsic Dynamics in Latent World Models
stories.author: Jingwen Fu
bullet_points: The research addresses a key challenge in world models: separating action-consequence relationships from irrelevant visual noise in latent representations.
The study investigates the link between 'action predictability' (reconstructing actions from latent states) and the preservation of intrinsic dynamics.
The core hypothesis suggests that promoting action predictability can help stabilize and improve the learning of intrinsic dynamics within these models.

stories.title: Evaluating Inquiry Learning in LLM-Based Agents: Hypothesizing, Reasoning, and Exploration
stories.author: Tanja Käser
bullet_points: The paper addresses the gap in current LLM evaluation by examining how models integrate the full scientific inquiry cycle (exploration, hypothesis, reasoning).
It acknowledges that LLMs already show strength in isolated components like inductive reasoning and hypothesis generation.
The research focuses on building and testing LLM-based agents capable of iterative, holistic scientific discovery.

stories.title: Decoding What iOS Location Services Send to Apple: An LLM Is an Unreliable Analyst but a Useful Toolmaker
stories.author: Douglas Leith
bullet_points: The research investigates using Large Language Models (LLMs) to assist in reverse engineering proprietary data formats (protobufs) from iOS location services.
The study tests frontier models (Claude Opus 4.8, Codex GPT Sol 5.6) against network traffic captured from iPhones.
The findings indicate that while LLMs are a useful toolmaker in this process, they are an unreliable analyst, producing schemas with substantial, hard-to-detect errors.

stories.title: LoopAhead: Speculating Ahead for Faster Decoding in Looped Language Models
stories.author: Zhiyong Chen
bullet_points: The paper introduces 'LoopAhead' to address high decoding latency in Looped Language Models.
Looped Transformers are efficient but suffer from sequential computation during token generation.
LoopAhead aims to better exploit early-loop features compared to existing pipelined self-speculative decoding methods.

stories.title: LOADBench: A Large Open Analog Dataset and Benchmark for Machine Learning in IC Design
stories.author: R. Martins
bullet_points: Introduces LOADBench, a large, open-source dataset and benchmark specifically for Machine Learning in Analog IC Design.
Addresses the critical industry problem of unreliable comparisons due to the lack of standardized evaluation and proprietary datasets in analog ML research.
The dataset includes over 100 operational amplifier (opamp) topologies fabricated in the SkyWater130 process.

stories.title: ClaimScope: Label-Blind Witness Verification for Mathematical Claim Auditing
stories.author: Mushir Akhtar
bullet_points: Introduces ClaimScope, a new 72-task benchmark designed to audit mathematical claims beyond simple answer accuracy.
The auditing process involves a multi-faceted verdict, scope definition, counterexample identification, and repair suggestion.
Evaluates large language models (like Qwen3-8B) on mathematical reasoning using a witness checker that validates the model's submitted state.

stories.title: Modeling and Understanding Neural Weights of Humanoid Policies with Diffusion
stories.author: Koushil Sreenath
bullet_points: The research focuses on humanoid control policies, a rapidly advancing area in robotics.
It addresses a gap by attempting to model the distribution of learned neural network weights directly, rather than just training the networks conventionally.
The proposed method utilizes diffusion models to generate functional control networks within the weight space.

stories.title: Hierarchical Residual Policy Learning for Real-World Mobile Manipulation with Sparse Human Guidance
stories.author: Jiachen Li
bullet_points: Introduces HiRe-MoMa, a framework designed for stable and sample-efficient real-world fine-tuning of Mobile Manipulation (MoMa) systems.
Addresses key challenges in MoMa, specifically high-dimensional action spaces and complex module coupling.
Utilizes a Hierarchical Residual Architecture as its core mechanism for improving robotic control.

stories.title: Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents
stories.author: Jiaxuan You
bullet_points: The research addresses the computational bottleneck in training language agents caused by expensive long-horizon rollouts.
It critiques existing methods in agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) that fail to effectively utilize intermediate step supervision.
The proposed method, 'Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting,' aims to improve supervision beyond just the final scalar reward.

stories.title: Continuum Attention
stories.author: Afshin Khadangi
bullet_points: Introduces Continuum Attention (CA), a novel causal Transformer attention operator.
Replaces discrete key/value lookup with integration over a continuous, piecewise linear memory curve.
Enables exact normalized attention calculation from closed-form exponential moments, simplifying gradient computation.

stories.title: Latent Compaction with Test-Time Training
stories.author: Xu Han
bullet_points: Addresses the memory and computational burden of large KV caches in long-context LLMs.
Introduces 'Latent Compaction,' a method to create compact, document-specific caches via test-time training.
Uses initialization techniques like reconstruction importance and teacher attention to ensure information preservation during compression.

stories.title: One Task, Many Interfaces: Simple Cross-Interface Consistency Training Improves LLM Agent Robustness
stories.author: Peng Qi
bullet_points: LLM agents suffer from interface binding, meaning their performance degrades when the input interface is slightly altered from the training setup.
The paper proposes 'Cross-Interface Consistency Training' to improve LLM agent robustness against interface variations.
The research addresses the limitation of current methods, which only broaden dependence on the training interface distribution rather than solving the core out-of-distribution robustness issue.

stories.title: Recovering Reliable Supervision via Critique-Guided On-Policy Distillation
stories.author: Taylor W. Killian
bullet_points: Addresses a critical failure mode in On-Policy Distillation (OPD) where teachers fail to recover from student errors.
Introduces 'CriticOPD,' a novel method that uses a critic to guide the teacher's critique of incorrect student rollouts.
Focuses on improving the reliability of supervision in model distillation processes, a key area in advanced reinforcement learning.

stories.title: SCRIBE: Scalable Contextual Representations of Interpretable Brain-Grounded Semantics
stories.author: Mariya Toneva
bullet_points: Introduces SCRIBE, a new framework designed to model brain-grounded semantics.
SCRIBE uses a neuroscience-informed semantic space combined with an ensemble of LLMs.
The goal is to generate interpretable, word-level semantic representations from real-world text for brain study.

stories.title: Decomposing Brain-LLM Alignment with Interpretable Semantic Representations
stories.author: Mariya Toneva
bullet_points: The research addresses the interpretability challenge in aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with neural brain activity.
A novel method, SCRIBE, is introduced to provide an interpretable semantic representation grounded in neurocognitive properties.
The study uses variance partitioning between LLaMA2-7B and SCRIBE on fMRI data to decompose brain-LLM alignment.

stories.title: OPRD: On-Policy Reminder Distillation for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
stories.author: Ken Deng
bullet_points: Addresses the challenge of long-horizon coding agents failing to utilize contextual information effectively.
Introduces On-Policy Reminder Distillation (OPRD) to improve agent reliability and constraint adherence.
OPRD combines Multi-Scope Reminder supervision with outcome-based routing for better process supervision.

stories.title: Can LLMs Tell Stories Out of Order? A Corpus and Benchmark for Nonlinear Narrative Generation
stories.author: Tenghao Huang
bullet_points: Introduces a new benchmark to test Large Language Models (LLMs) on nonlinear narrative generation.
The benchmark analyzes 83 published works, distinguishing between event chronology and narrative presentation order.
The study uses detailed annotations, including causal dependencies and character knowledge, to evaluate model performance.

stories.title: Trajectory-Level Speculation with Semantic Verification for Tool-Using Agents
stories.author: Zhijiang Guo
bullet_points: Addresses the inefficiency of using a single large language model (LLM) for all steps in complex, tool-using agent tasks.
Proposes a new method for 'Trajectory-Level Speculation' combined with semantic verification to improve agent performance.
Aims to leverage smaller, more efficient models for routine steps while maintaining accuracy via verification against a strong model.

stories.title: Translation Circuit Discovery and Targeted Optimization for Low-Resource Multilingual Translation
stories.author: Md Shad Akhtar
bullet_points: The research addresses the lack of understanding regarding internal mechanisms in LLMs for low-resource multilingual translation.
It focuses on studying translation circuits within decoder-only LLMs, specifically for Hindi-to-Urdu and Hindi-to-Sindhi.
A new mechanistic framework, TITAN, is proposed, utilizing causal intervention and targeted optimization to improve translation performance.

stories.title: RPKI now protects 70% of internet routes
stories.author: emot
bullet_points: RPKI adoption has reached a significant milestone, covering 70% of internet routes.
This indicates a growing global effort to improve internet routing security.
The increase in RPKI coverage suggests a reduction in BGP hijacking risks.

stories.title: Business accounts will consent to Meta scraping their websites Starting Oct. 30
stories.author: 0in
bullet_points: Meta is implementing a policy change regarding website scraping.
Business accounts will be required to consent to Meta scraping their sites.
This change is scheduled to take effect on October 30th.

stories.title: I built a lie detector for AI coding agents. Then I read the rules.
stories.author: dannwaneri
bullet_points: The article discusses a project involving a lie detector specifically designed for AI coding agents.
The core problem addressed is the discrepancy between an AI agent's stated change (e.g., 'fixed typos') and the actual code modification.
The piece suggests a focus on verifying the integrity and accuracy of claims made by autonomous AI agents.
